target_name: Chronic External Dependence of the Research Program
rationale: This is a horizon re-parameterization of the archive's "External Funding Intensity of the Research Program" (same numerator variables, same denominator concept, only 3-year sums replacing the 1-year/3-year-MA pairing), which is precisely the kind of cosmetic variant that adds smoothing rather than a new economic distinction, and the "chronic vs. one-off" claim is not actually identified because a single large raise in the window still dominates the three-year sum.

target_name: Externally Funded While Losing the Innovation Race
rationale: The economic motivation for complementarity is fair, but the stated construction is internally inconsistent — ZSCORE of an IND_RANK centers the funding leg at the *industry median* of the ratio, not at zero net financing, so the claimed "net payers score negative" sign-flip point is wrong and the multiplicative weight will flip sign for firms that are still net raisers; combined with an intersected sub-5% universe and near-duplication of the archive's existing "Issuance While Losing the Innovation Race," the incremental information is likely small.

target_name: Allocation Shift From Research to Shareholders
rationale: The diagnosis (level ratio's large alpha with wrong-signed FMB slope is a maturity/factor-loading sort) is correct and within-firm demeaning is the right decisive test, though the archive's already-failed "Payout Accelerating as Research Decelerates" tests essentially the same change-based harvesting event and suggests the answer will be a null, and the MA-of-a-ratio-of-a-ratio construction is numerically fragile even after winsorization.

The claim that gross repayment is "mechanically unrelated to net financing" is false — dltr enters the archive's strongest signal with a negative sign, so this proposal predicts *low* returns for exactly the firms that signal marks as high-return, an unacknowledged sign contradiction; on top of that, dltr/R&D is dominated by leverage scale and debt-maturity structure rather than any crowding-out of the research budget.

A legitimate external-validity test that escapes the R&D-reporter universe with a defensible alternative intangible-output proxy and a clean nonnegative weight, but it risks largely reloading on the well-known net share issuance anomaly conditioned by the equally well-known gross-margin-change signal, so the burden is on showing the interaction beats the additive combination of its two published parts.

target_name: New Claims Per Dollar of Total Intangible Capital
rationale: Changing the scaler from a flow to an intangible capital stock is a substantive rather than cosmetic revision and the coverage expansion to non-R&D intangible-heavy firms is a real test of mechanism generality, but for firms with small intan and zero-coalesced R&D the denominator can be near-zero, so the extreme deciles may be scaler noise rather than dilution — report results with and without a minimum-denominator screen.
